content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I recently updated my [product_name] to [version_no] and tried to open a project created in a previous version that was already deployed on a [product_name] device to make some changes. Although I received a message stating that the software would open a copy of the project in the current version and it may take a few seconds, the project did not open and Java errors appeared. Thank you in advance for your help.
After uninstalling and reinstalling the software, the problem was resolved.

analysis.insight_summary: A user faced an issue upgrading from one version of [product_name] to another. Opening a project from the previous version showed a conversion notification, but the process failed and Java error messages appeared. Reinstalling the application resolved the issue.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated full backward compatibility and the ability to open and modify projects from earlier versions of the software in the updated release without errors.
